day_focus: Prioritize the health of your business and body today, but keep your heart anchored in the home.
checkin: It's Melaleuca Monday, son; take care of the business and your wellness, but don't let the hustle outpace the home. Remember that the most important investment you'll ever make isn't in a product or a plan, but in the people sitting across the table from you. Walk slow, breathe deep, and lead with love today.
